resources.string: Number of pieces on the box
All pieces fit in one photo. Spread them out flat with a little space between them.
Important: spread every pile out completely flat. Pieces must not be stacked and should not touch if possible.
Only the square frame is photographed and analyzed. All pieces of a pile must lie completely inside it. You can also upload an existing photo (icon next to the button).
Check that all pieces are in the photo: pieces under other pieces or outside the photo are not detected.
Possible reasons: the puzzle has more pieces than stated, pieces of another puzzle got mixed in, or pieces were counted twice.
If you want to be sure, lay the pieces out with some space between them and count again.
To photograph the puzzle pieces, the app needs access to the camera.

Move the photo and zoom with two fingers until all puzzle pieces are inside the square. Only what you see in the square is counted.
Square: move and zoom the photo
Choose an image and adjust the brightness

PuzzleCounter uses the camera (or a photo you pick from your gallery) only to detect and count puzzle pieces. The photos are analyzed directly on your device by a built-in TensorFlow Lite model and are never sent to servers, cloud services or third parties. The most recently analyzed photos are stored only on your device; you can view and delete them in the developer inspector.
Developed as a private project for counting puzzle pieces.
This app is based on open-source technologies such as Jetpack Compose, CameraX and TensorFlow Lite.
The saved photos and detections of the last scans will be removed from this device. The history of checks is kept.
